goal: Bring the public memory ledger to a verified next step while preserving copy-on-write sharing and per-process write fault accounting.

runtime.cow_policy: After fork, parent and child share every page read-only. A write to a shared page faults and allocates one private copy (one extra physical page) in the writing process only.

pending_decision.question: After fork, the child wrote 640 distinct pages and the parent wrote 96 other distinct pages. How many bytes of additional physical memory were allocated by copy-on-write duplication (page size 4096 B)?
pending_decision.controller_note: The memory ledger is blocked until the COW extra allocation is verified.

current_state.observation_boundary: All facts above are public observations. No hidden expected schedule is supplied. The controller is waiting on the pending decision value; a bounded verification of that value is the useful delegation now. Do not claim a blocked task ran.

probe.intended_question: Additional physical bytes allocated by copy-on-write duplication.
probe.derivation: child 640 private pages + parent 96 private pages = 736 pages copied; 736 * 4096 = 3014656 bytes.
